# An Asset reports only its own status, in sequence

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll two Assets

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<first asset>",
  "request_id": "<first asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<first asset credential>",
  "alias": "First"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "First",
    "command_manifest": [],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      }
    },
    "id": "<first asset>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": null,
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

## 2. A fresh report updates status and contact

SDK `PATCH /entities/<first asset>/status` with <first asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "ready"
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "First",
  "command_manifest": [],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "healthy"
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": "<time>"
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": "<time>",
      "value": "ready"
    }
  },
  "id": "<first asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 2
}
```

## 3. Resending the same report returns the Asset unchanged

SDK `PATCH /entities/<first asset>/status` with <first asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "ready"
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "First",
  "command_manifest": [],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "healthy"
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": "<time>"
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": "<time>",
      "value": "ready"
    }
  },
  "id": "<first asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 2
}
```

## 4. Reusing a report ID with different facts conflicts

SDK `PATCH /entities/<first asset>/status` with <first asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "busy"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "report_conflict",
  "message": "The report ID was already used with different facts."
}
```

## 5. A report that is not newer is rejected

SDK `PATCH /entities/<first asset>/status` with <first asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<stale report>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "stopped"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "report_out_of_order",
  "message": "The report sequence is not newer than the last accepted report."
}
```

## 6. Another Asset cannot report for this Asset

SDK `PATCH /entities/<first asset>/status` with <second asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<foreign report>",
  "sequence": 2,
  "status": "stopped"
}
```

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "Only the assigned Asset may report its state."
}
```

## 7. An operator cannot report Asset status

SDK `PATCH /entities/<first asset>/status` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<operator report>",
  "sequence": 2,
  "status": "stopped"
}
```

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "This credential may not call this operation."
}
```
